summary: Multiplies a 3x3 matrix (the this object, 9 doubles at offsets 0x0..0x40, indexed this[0]..this[8]) by a 3-element input vector a2 (a2[0..2]) and stores the result into the output vector a3 (a3[0..2]). Row 0 reads this[0]/this[3]/this[6], row 1 reads this[1]/this[4]/this[7], row 2 reads this[2]/this[5]/this[8]. Returns the input vector pointer a2. Structural twin of the Matrix3x3VectorMultiply cluster representative per the cluster prelabel.

operations.description: Row 0 of the product: a3[0] = this[6] * a2[2] + this[3] * a2[1] + a2[0] * this[0], i.e. matrix elements at this+0x30, this+0x18, this+0x00 times vector components a2[2]/a2[1]/a2[0].
Row 1 of the product: a3[1] = this[1] * a2[0] + this[7] * a2[2] + this[4] * a2[1], i.e. matrix elements at this+0x08, this+0x38, this+0x20 times vector components a2[0]/a2[2]/a2[1].
Row 2 of the product: a3[2] = this[2] * a2[0] + this[8] * a2[2] + this[5] * a2[1], i.e. matrix elements at this+0x10, this+0x40, this+0x28 times vector components a2[0]/a2[2]/a2[1].
Return the input vector pointer a2 (the caller-visible result; Hex-Rays result alias).
